Unleash: You may have this creature enter with a +1/+1 counter. It can't block as long as it has a +1/+1 counter.
Valiant: Triggers whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability you control.
Vanishing: This enters with N time counters. At your upkeep, remove one. When the last is removed, sacrifice it.
Venture into the dungeon: Enter or advance through a dungeon.
Vigilance: Attacking doesn't cause this creature to tap.
Vivid: A color-related mechanic involving mana or color-based effects.
Void: An ability related to the exile zone or nothingness.
Vote: Each player votes for one of the given options.
Ward: Whenever this permanent becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter it unless that player pays the ward cost.
Warp: Move or shift permanents or cards between zones.
Waterbend: A bending ability themed around water manipulation.
Web-slinging: An ability themed around Spider-Man's web mechanics.
Will of the council: Each player votes. The option with the most votes takes effect.
Wither: This deals damage to creatures in the form of -1/-1 counters.
Wizardcycling: Discard this card and pay the cost to search your library for a Wizard card.
